headline: Khaitan & Co advises Reliance Industries on ₹12,000 crore NCD issuance
sum: Reliance Industries Limited has made an issuance of unsecured, non-convertible debentures aggregating to ₹12,000 crore, on a private placement basis. Khaitan & Co advised Reliance Industries on this NCD issuance.
detail: Reliance Industries Limited has made an issuance of unsecured, non-convertible debentures aggregating to ₹12,000 crore, on a private placement basis. Khaitan & Co advised Reliance Industries on this NCD issuance. The transaction team consisted of Manisha Shroff (Partner), Gyana Pathak (Senior Associate), Akshansh Sharma (Senior Associate) and Nandini Arya (Associate). The Debentures carry a coupon rate of 7.47% per annum and are listed on both BSE Limited and National Stock Exchange of India Limited.
